full_text: Intro Encompass® Consulting Services Tired of having to deal with inefficient practices, compliance loopholes, or unutilized functions? Encompass® Consulting services will streamline your workflows and automate processes, enabling your LOS to work for you. Whether it is for your very first implementation of Encompass® or for the optimization of a legacy setup, our experts have delivered solutions that foster real results! Get expert guidance that transforms how you lend— book your free consultation today . Full Name Email Contact No. Message Page URL Home » Encompass Consulting Services Complete Solutions for your Pro Encompass® Expertise and Experience Our Encompass® consulting services are unparalleled in the industry and aim to enhance your mortgage operations. Our people bring deep platform knowledge, technical capability, and hands-on industry experience to each engagement. Whether you need implementation, workflow optimization, API integration, or custom development, we customize Encompass for your unique business needs. From origination start-ups to enterprise lenders, our encompass consulting group has partnered with lenders of all types to combat inefficiencies, increase compliance, and shorten loan cycles. Our Encompass® consultants know Encompass® inside and out; they also live and breathe its challenges, be they regulatory or otherwise. Providing flexible, sustainable solutions, we empower your team to maximize Encompass® functionality. Leverage us for tactical and technical leadership, with insight on digitized lending! Get Started Now! Explore how mortgage Encompass® Consulting Services can work with you to resolve complexity, offer smooth operations, and let you achieve your strategic goals. We design result-driven solutions! Contact us Our Encompass® Consulting Services We offer comprehensive solutions tailored to drive strategic growth, operational efficiency, and sustainable success. Let’s explore them: Encompass® Implementation We effectively implement Encompass® to your mortgage business. Our team of Encompass® consultants will make sure that you have a minimal disruption to your operations and maximum return on investment. We align the settings on the platform as per your workflows, configuring the platform and taking your business ahead through the entire support process! API Integration Our Encompass® consulting group creates custom API integrations connecting Encompass® to your various third-party systems. We are experts in ensuring that the integrations are secure, efficient and automation minimizes manual effort, improves accuracy, and gives decision makers time to act on real-time! We foster reliable information across the mortgage technology ecosystem. Encompass® Customization Smart customizations maximize Encompass® functionality according to how your business logic operates. Company specific forms, input screens, business rules and alerts can be easily tailored to how your workflows operate, allowing your team to move smarter, faster and more accurately. We provide Encompass® consultancy to make most from the functional benefits of Encompass and adapt these functionalities. Encompass® LOS Optimization We review and optimize your Encompass® Loan Origination System (LOS) to improve efficiency, and provide compliance and reduced cycle times. Every aspect of loan origination system optimization—from data validation to task automation—will enhance both user productivity and borrower experience—so you can close more loans, faster, with fewer costly mistakes! Why Choose Our Encompass® Experts? We have certified professionals who deliver customized, efficient Encompass® solutions to maximize your mortgage ROI. They are the first to be trusted because: On Time Delivery Our Encompass® consultants offer services on time without compromising quality. We follow standardized processes and an agile approach ensures you will launch your Encompass® project on time and start operating smoothly and productively on day 1. 24/7 Support You can depend on us 24 x 7 for Encompass® 360 consultancy. If you have tech issues, need an Encompass® update or if there is some urgent fixing needed; we will be there at the moment's notice. You can rely on us to minimize downtime while maximizing efficiency. Experience and Expertise Our team of Encompass® consultants uses a combination of Encompass-specific experience and mortgage industry knowledge to leverage where there are opportunities in your Encompass® system; if for complex customizations, or ESD (Encompass® Software Development) and integrations. We know how to operate inside this level of complexity to constructively yield real operational value. Future Development We build your Encompass® solutions to ensure where the scale grows with your development. Our offer of mortgage Encompasses® consulting services comes with future development in mind; knowing that technology keeps changing, and that your lending business is also not static! Achieve Operational Excellence With Encompass® Consulting Services Supercharge your mortgage operations with our Encompass® consultancy on Encompass® promising results. Our mortgage Encompass® consultants don’t just configure your LOS; they take the time to think over every aspect of your LOS to the way you do business. Our consulting process covers custom workflows, API integrations, automation, and coordinating your compliance offerings efficiently. Our goal of Encompass® consulting is to eliminate inefficiencies, enhance workflow with automation, and to ultimately reduce errors, while expediting loan closure. With years of real-world experience coupled with a deep understanding of the Encompass® platform and the mortgage industry as a whole, we eliminate inefficiencies, add new functionality, and prepare your platform for the future of your organization. Avail our encompass consulting services to transform your Encompass® platform into a high-powered vehicle for operational excellence! Drive Revenues By Partnering With Us! Our Encompass® Consulting Services deliver exceptional results by utilizing extensive technical expertise and advanced knowledge of mortgage technology. Using the latest Encompass platform capabilities, APIs, and automation tools, we provide consulting services tailored to your business requirements. Our comprehensive approach towards Encompass® 360 consulting complements best practices in your industry with technology, including in-depth knowledge of the loan origination industry. Indeed, our Encompass® consultants focus on custom integrations, automating workflow processes, implementing compliance changes/upgrades, and improving data accuracy to provide solutions. Indeed we enhance your productivity while reducing risk. Come to us for expertise, for advanced technology solution implementation, or simply for a partnership to shape your mortgage business! Looking For Something Else? Find answers to common questions about our Encompass® Consulting Services What does an Encompass® consultant do? An Encompass® consultant is an expert configuring, customizing and optimizing the Encompass® Loan Origination System (LOS) . This includes all aspects of the project from implementation to designing workflows and creating API integrations, rules, documents, and providing training. The consultant works directly with your team and business goals to configure Encompass® so that it is efficiently possible with less friction, making your operations smoother, compliance better and more consistent operations through the entire loan lifecycle. How long does it take to implement or reconfigure Encompass®? The length of time it takes to implement or reconfigure Encompass® depends on your needs. If it is simply an out-of-the-box solution then it could take weeks or even a few months to implement, however, if the implementation is a complete implementation with integrations, custom development and training, this can take 2 to 3 months or more. What industries or company sizes benefit most from Encompass® consulting? The primary beneficiaries of mortgage Encompass® consulting services are organizations engaged in mortgage lending activities, specifically mortgage lenders, mortgage brokers, mortgage credit unions and banks that originate residential loans. Mid-size and large lenders with expansive and complex operations benefit more, while small lending firms with a motivation to streamline their processes or grow rapidly may need the insight from professional externals that enhance their competitive advantages. Do consultants assist with migrating from another LOS to Encompass®? The mortgage Encompass® consultants will assess your current LOS, define data and process mapping and facilitate the movement of your individuals and their data to ensure a seamless and secure movement. Their role in migration includes: validation of data and content imports, custom on-site configurations, user training, and change management – if planned well and the resources are available it should ultimately manage various associated risks and disruption to the organization, and one of the added benefits and control would be how quickly the organization’s staff could be up and running on the new system at the onset. How can Encompass® consulting improve my mortgage operations? Encompass® consulting can optimize your entire mortgage operation by configuring the platform to best align with your workflows, automating repetitive tasks, and minimizing compliance risk. Consultants can consolidate your loan processing, utilize better data accuracy, integrate the tools you need to better manage your business, and provide more real-time reporting which will lead to faster closings at a lower cost, and a better borrower experience. Ultimately, it helps transform Encompass from a software solution to an asset that drives performance. How much do Encompass® consulting services cost? The cost of Encompass® consulting services will depend on the complexity of the project, the scope of the implementation, and the length of the project. Consulting fees can vary with hourly projections from $100 to $250 per hour with project-based fee schedules available for larger implementations or engagements that require longer-term assistance. If there’s anything else you’d like to know about Encompass® Consulting , feel free to reach out. Partner with our expert mortgage encompass consultants today and improve your mortgage processes and outcomes! Let’s Connect!
